AODS · page templates

Whole pages, made only of system components

Seven source pages that link dist/ and carry nothing but aods- markup copied from the registry, in the canonical order: skip-link, site-alert, header, main#main, footer. Each has a self-contained .bundle.html twin with dist/ inlined. The order of components on every page is manifest.pages[].order, read here at load.

    What the pages needed that the system does not yet have: a block inset for main (the pages bind --s-space-4xl in templates.css; there is no c.page rhythm token), a description slot on a vertical step, and a narrower aside than s.size.measure-aside (480px) for an in-page nav. Everything else composed without a line of page CSS.
